instruction: Make an order for 4 'Codenames Board Game's, 3 'Garmin Forerunner 245's, and 2 'RUSCH Wall Clock's from amazon for my parents' home address.
notes: Two apps: phone (to find the parents' home address via search_contacts with relationship=parent) and amazon (search each product by name, add it to the cart with the requested quantity, add the parents' address, pick a payment card, place the order). The cart is cleared first so the order contains exactly the three products with quantities 4/3/2 (the evaluation compares the order items dict exactly). Quantities are discrete objects tied to products via static desired-quantity facts. Cart contents are only addable before the order is placed, so the goal facts cart-has + order-placed + order-shipped-to together mean the placed order holds those items shipped to the parents' address. Address fields are objects parsed at runtime from the contact's home_address string; if show_addresses already lists the parents' address the agent may reuse that address_id instead of calling add_address (adding is harmless per evaluation). supervisor-complete-task carries the task records as non-API parameters so its precondition is the lifted conjunction of the goal; it is the only action producing task-completed and every other action requires (not (task-completed)).

plan: (amazon-add-address parents-home-addr-name parents-home-street parents-home-city parents-home-state parents-home-country parents-home-zipcode amazon-token parents-home-address)
(supervisor-complete-task codenames-board-game quantity-4 garmin-forerunner-245 quantity-3 rusch-wall-clock quantity-2 parents-home-address)
